svg.text: Notes
A: Invoices sits after Checklist and before Photos, at every status but Canceled. Empty, it's the heading and Send invoice.
A: Send invoice is the section's secondary button, so the bar's step stays the page's one primary.
A at 320: the heading and Send invoice share one row; below 640 each invoice's steps sit under its number.
Steps: filled dots for reached, hollow for not yet, no lines between; Paid is StatusMark's finished check in --ok.
B: an open job's bar already holds Add photo/video and the next step, so a third button would wrap at 320.
B in Review: Send invoice would take the disabled In review button's place beside Add photo/video.
B: open jobs then need a second home for Send invoice (M7: any job but Canceled), two places for one action.
Sheet: Send invoice stays off until one file is up; the line under it says why (Finishing 1 upload, or Retry).
Sheet at 320: the fields stay side by side at 138 each; the footer pair splits the width as Mark done's does.
Sheet fields: "(optional)" follows the label in --muted-foreground, as the lease and listing forms label theirs.
Sent: with Job emails off it reads "Check back here to see when it's paid." payoffLine gains this invoice pair.
Link session: no invoice rows at all (M16, 5.2), so the section is only its heading and Send invoice.
Link session: Sign in opens /login?next= this job with ?do=invoice, so the sheet opens once they're in.
Phone drops nothing; the photo runs full width above the title as today, and the steps move under the number.
Refs: Remote and Shopee 3-step trackers, OKX and Cleo upload tiles in a sheet, Turo repair invoice (Mobbin).
